sources.title: 奈良场胜江户易占研究随笔提1689《新刻看命一掌金》和1705《和解》次第
sources.provider: Naraba Masaru author-maintained academic research commentary
sources.quality_notes: Scholar's public research note states Genroku2 1689 printed Shin Koku Kanmei Isshokin followed by Baba 1705 explanatory text; no independently bound 1689 original copy/colophon in this batch. Chinese Tang Yixing attribution and links to 四柱子平 are not established.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: 1689 scholarly date cannot assign year to Kyoto RB00016486 undated print.
1705 different bookseller labels and 1787 reprint labels cannot prove plate/folio identity without source-level collation.
Kanmei Isshokin twelve-star/month-hour natal methods cannot be equated with Ziping Four-Pillars rules based only on a modern summary.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Find specifically identified 1689 printed folio/imprint before dating the first edition.
Compare original 1705 and 1787 colophons, diagrams, plate and page discontinuities from IIIF; preserve separate holdings.
Identify direct Chinese-version citation, if any, before asserting lineage to Japanese Kanmei or Ziping.
